title: Missing the Forest For the Trees
author: Nemefish
rules:
Missing the Forest For the Trees

Play on

Sudokubank

• Normal Sudoku rules apply.

• Dynamic Clues: Placing correct digits may cause additional clues to appear. Guessing is not required. Correctly placed digits will remain correct no matter what new clues are revealed.

• Index Lines (dark green): The digit in the Nth cell of an index line, counting from the diamond, gives the position on the line where the digit N appears. (e.g. If the number on the diamond is 4, then the digit 1 will appear on the 4th cell from the diamond)

• German Whispers (green): Along a German Whispers line, consecutive digits are at least 5 apart.

• Entropy Lines (orange): Every set of 3 digits on an entropy line must contain a low (1,2,3) medium (4,5,6) and high (7,8,9) digit.

• Parity line (red): Digits along a parity line alternate between even and odd.

I designed this puzzle to highlight the recent Dynamic Cluing feature added to Sudokubnak. I think it has great potential similar to Dynamic Fog of War to create insteresting puzzles and guide the solver along the solve path.
